LanguageData.QBR.MissingMods: This compatibility patch needs QualityBuilder ({0}) and Misc. Robots ({1}). Missing parts are switched off.
LanguageData.QBR.Enabled: Let robots work on quality builds
LanguageData.QBR.Enabled.Tip: A robot may finish a QualityBuilder frame if its quality roll can reach the minimum quality set on that frame. Off = QualityBuilder's original behaviour (robots never touch quality builds).
LanguageData.QBR.UseRobotSkill: Robots roll quality with their own skill
LanguageData.QBR.UseRobotSkill.Tip: Vanilla treats Misc. Robots as mechanoids and rolls every robot's quality with a fixed skill of 10, no matter its tier. With this on, a robot uses the skill level from its definition (e.g. Construction 4 / 8 / 13 / 16 / 20 for the Misc. Robots++ tiers). Applies to everything robots make, not only buildings.
LanguageData.QBR.RespectOverride.Tip: If you picked one specific pawn in QualityBuilder to do all quality builds, robots stay off them as well.
LanguageData.QBR.RespectExcludeMechs.Tip: Robots count as mechanoids for QualityBuilder. Leave this off if that option is only meant for Biotech mechs.
LanguageData.QBR.DebugLog.Tip: Writes one line per robot and frame to the log explaining why it was allowed or blocked (throttled).
LanguageData.QBR.Source.Exact: Static Quality – exact: quality follows the skill thresholds ({0}).{1}
LanguageData.QBR.Source.PM1: Static Quality – ±1: skill thresholds ({0}), then up to one step better or worse. A robot may build if the best case reaches the target.{1}
LanguageData.QBR.Source.PM2: Static Quality – ±2: skill thresholds ({0}), then up to two steps better or worse. A robot may build if the best case reaches the target.{1}
LanguageData.QBR.Source.Cheat: Static Quality – cheat: everything comes out at the top quality, so every robot may build.{0}
LanguageData.QBR.Source.Vanilla: Vanilla quality (Static Quality is not installed): the roll is random, so a robot may build if its chance to reach the target is at least the value below.
LanguageData.QBR.Source.VanillaViaSQ: Static Quality is set to "vanilla quality": the roll is random, so a robot may build if its chance to reach the target is at least the value below.
LanguageData.QBR.LegendaryNeedsInspiration: Legendary needs inspiration, which robots never get, so robots top out at Masterwork.
LanguageData.QBR.VanillaChance: Minimum chance to reach the target quality: {0}%
LanguageData.QBR.VanillaChance.Tip: Only used with vanilla quality rules. Lower = robots join more often but cause more QualityBuilder tear-down-and-rebuild cycles.
LanguageData.QBR.TableHeader: Which robot may build which target quality
LanguageData.QBR.TableNote: Columns are the minimum quality set on a QualityBuilder frame. The roll itself stays random as usual; if the result is too low, QualityBuilder tears it down and rebuilds as normal.
LanguageData.QBR.NoRobots: No robot type with Construction work found.
